note: Set A binds planform chordwise extents as "chord length" (-2.6 m and 2.5 m at r/R = 0.0) and reads the shear center at -4.0 m at r/R = 0.3, which is the lower planform edge, not the shear-center curve; it also gives the root mass center as 0.0 m and fabricates a [kg/m^3] quote. Set B avoids these property misbindings, reports the root axial stiffness (4.7e10 N) and the center-curve trends plausibly, and keeps pitch axis/shear center coverage. Both sets drop the 1e11/1e10 scale multipliers on several stiffness values and use N.m^-2 where the axis reads N.m^2, but B's residual problems (a vague "stiffness … series: green" claim, 3100 kg/m not matching its own quote, an r/B label) are fewer and less severe than A's invented bindings.
